inactive.title: Hero profile inactive
inactive.description: Your hero profile is suspended or pending. Meanwhile the portal is read only: you cannot create content, suggest links or edit the profile.
inactive.descriptionNamed: The profile of {name} is suspended or pending. Meanwhile the portal is read only: you cannot create content, suggest links or edit the profile.

unlinked.title: Account without a hero profile
unlinked.description: Your account has the hero role but is not linked to an active profile. Accept the invitation you received by email or contact the administration.

acting_unavailable.title: Publish as hero unavailable
acting_unavailable.description: The database in this environment does not have the update that lets the admin team publish for heroes yet (0045).

unavailable.help: Questions? Contact the Groscove Ultra editorial team. Remember: heroes on this platform are fictional and this is a demo environment.

dashboard.title: Hello, {name}
dashboard.description: Publish your videos and follow your content, editorial feedback and product links.
dashboard.archived: {count, plural, =1 {1 content item archived} other {# content items archived}} by the administration.
dashboard.returnedDescription: The editorial team left feedback. Adjust and publish when ready.
dashboard.linksHint: Suggest products related to your content.

content.newDescription: Create a draft of a workout, guide, article or linked video. Save and publish when ready.
content.description: Your content in every state. Drafts can be edited; to change a published item, unpublish it first.
content.count: {count, plural, =0 {No content} =1 {1 content item} other {# content items}}
content.tableCaption: List of my content with status, review and actions
content.emptyDescription: Create the first draft: video, workout, guide or article.

edit.accessNote: You publish and unpublish your content. Access rule (free or premium), module and featuring are set by the administration, which can also archive content.

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: Edit freely. When ready, tap Publish: it goes live right away.

in_review.title: Under review
in_review.description: Sent to the editorial team through the old review flow. You can wait for the decision or publish directly.

returned.title: Returned for changes
returned.description: Read the feedback, adjust the draft and publish when ready.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: The editorial team did not approve this version. Review the draft before publishing.

published.title: Published
published.description: It is live. To edit, unpublish it: it goes back to draft and you publish again.

archived.title: Archived
archived.description: Archived by the administration. Read-only, and it cannot go live again from here.

edit.notFoundDescription: It may have been removed or belong to another hero.

publish.title: Publish this content?
publish.description: It goes live right away with what is already saved. The administration can archive it later if needed.
publish.incomplete: {count, plural, =1 {1 recommended item is missing. You can publish anyway; title, body and the video (for video posts) are required.} other {# recommended items are missing. You can publish anyway; title, body and the video (for video posts) are required.}}
publish.unpublishDescription: It goes offline and back to draft so you can edit it. Then just publish again.
publish.unpublishedDescription: The content is back to draft.

post.title: New post
post.description: Take or choose a photo, or record a video up to 3 minutes long. Add a title and publish.
post.recordHint: Opens the camera to record up to 3 minutes
post.galleryHint: A photo or video already on your device
post.limits: Photo up to 30 MB · video up to 3 minutes and 2 GB
post.notConfigured: Video is not set up yet: ask the administrator to turn on Cloudflare Stream.
post.uploadInBackground: You can write while the video uploads.
post.captionPlaceholder: Say in a few lines what the video is about
post.processingHint: Cloudflare is preparing the video. It usually takes less than a minute.
post.publishHintUpload: The button unlocks when the video finishes uploading.
post.discardDescription: The upload stops, the draft and the video are deleted and you go back to choose another video.
post.discardedDeleted: The draft and the video were deleted.
post.discardFailedDescription: Try again. Meanwhile, the draft stays in My content.
post.leaveWarning: The video is still uploading. If you leave now, the upload stops.
post.leaveWarningProcessing: The video is uploaded and being prepared. If you leave now, the post stays as a draft in My content.
post.leaveWarningText: The video stays as a draft in My content, but the title and caption you wrote will be lost.

sr.uploaded: Video uploaded. You can publish now.
sr.resuming: Connection is back. Resuming the upload.
sr.processing: The video is being prepared. Please wait.

reviews.title: Review history
reviews.description: Each publication (or review submission) opens a round; the team's decisions and feedback appear here.
reviews.emptyDescription: When you publish content, the history appears here.

links.description: Suggest demo-store products related to your content. Illustrative prices; no real purchases.
links.how1: You suggest; the administration validates or rejects. Only validated links are shown to the public.
links.how2: If the supplier makes a significant change to the product (title, category, type, attributes or food information), the validated link is suspended automatically until revalidated.
links.how3: You can delete a suggestion while it has not been evaluated yet.
links.contentHint: One of your content items (any status except archived).
links.noContents: Create a content item before suggesting links.
links.searchHint: Search by title among published, available products.
links.noResults: No purchasable product with that title.
links.noteHint: Why this product fits the content (optional).
links.suggestedDescription: The administration will evaluate the link.
links.tableCaption: Links suggested by me and their statuses
links.emptyDescription: Use the form above to suggest the first link.
links.deleteDescription: The suggestion for "{product}" will be removed. You can suggest it again later.

profile.editorDescription: What you change here shows on your public hero page.
profile.inactiveNotice: Profile suspended or pending: editing is locked until the administration reactivates it.
profile.lockedFields: Name, slug, pillars and the rights note are managed by the platform. You edit headline, bio, photo, cover and socials.
profile.headline: Headline

profile.photoHint: One photo for everything: it shows on your avatar and on your public hero page. Without a photo, your initials are shown.

cover.title: Cover
cover.hint: A real photo shown at the top of your card in the heroes list. Only upload a photo of you or one you have the right to use.
